findings: Knowledge pack loading accepts arbitrary filesystem paths without validating they're not sensitive system locations. While documented as operator-supplied (trusted context), recommend adding validation to reject paths like /etc/, /sys/, /proc/ as defense-in-depth to prevent accidental misconfiguration. Current whitelist-based filename validation provides strong protection against direct exploitation.

Recommend adding resolved path validation after pack_path / filename combination (line 161 in knowledge.py) to verify the resolved path stays within the pack directory, preventing potential symlink-based attacks. Current exact filename whitelist prevents direct traversal attacks but explicit boundary check would strengthen defense-in-depth.

JSON files loaded without explicit size limits could theoretically cause resource exhaustion with extremely large files. Low risk given operator-controlled context, but recommend adding file size validation (e.g., max 10MB per file) before JSON parsing for production hardening.
